chars.BOY: BOY: a Moroccan teenage boy about 17, short black curly hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark grey joggers, white sneakers
chars.STEPMOM: STEPMOM: a Moroccan woman about 35, wearing a bright emerald-green house kaftan with gold trim, a burgundy headscarf tied back, gold bangles
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan man about 50, short grey hair and grey moustache, wearing a navy blue work jacket over a white collared shirt, beige trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a dark hallway through a half-open door: in a Moroccan living room with low sedari sofas, STEPMOM stands crying and pointing angrily toward the hallway while talking to DAD who just came home from work; head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible, tense dramatic mood

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in a Moroccan living room: STEPMOM wipes tears with her hand, sobbing theatrically, while DAD listens with a frowning angry face, his fists clenched; evening lamp light

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: BOY sits on the tiled staircase of a Moroccan apartment in the dark, hugging his knees, eyes wet, secretly listening to voices coming from the lit living room below; sad but cinematic

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room, DAD points sternly at the front door while BOY stands in front of him with his head down, shocked; DAD's face angry and cold

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BOY alone in his small bedroom in a Moroccan apartment, sitting on the edge of the bed holding his head in his hands, worried and lost, a small window with city night lights

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: BOY stands by a window holding an old mobile phone, looking far away toward a distant Moroccan town at night, lonely, feeling that nobody can take him in

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: BOY packs a few clothes into a worn sports bag on his bed in a small Moroccan bedroom, tears on his face, moving fast

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At the apartment front door, BOY holds his sports bag and looks back hopefully over his shoulder at DAD, who stands in the corridor with arms crossed, silent and cold

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room, STEPMOM stands right behind DAD whispering into his ear with a sly small smile, her hand on his shoulder, while DAD stares ahead seriously; she clearly controls him
